name: Orc-Blooded Tiefling (Bloodborn Tiefling)
body:
Next to humans, orcs may be the most common species to produce tieflings. Orcs may look upon these strangely malformed children with suspicion—and not all of them survive to adulthood. Those who do, however, soon prove themselves useful in the meritocracy that is the orcish battlefield, and thus find almost limitless potential among their orcish kin.

Ancestry Varies.

Typical Alignment Chaotic Evil.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Str, +2 Dex, –2 Cha. This trait alters your ability scores and replaces fiendish sorcery.
Alternate Spell-Like Ability You gain boiling blood as a spell-like ability.
Battlefield Training You gain a +2 species bonus to Intimidate checks. In addition, you are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon. This trait replaces skilled.
Alternate Species Traits
Dwarf-Blooded Your ancestors were either dwarves or duergars, and this heritage is reflected strongly in you. You count as both a native outsider and a dwarf for any effects related to your species. You use the height, weight, and age charts for dwarves instead of those normally used for tieflings, and you gain a dwarf’s slow and steady and stability species traits. This trait alters your type.
Elf-Blooded Your ancestry is with the elven peoples instead of humans. Perhaps one of your ancestors made an unholy pacts with a fiend in order to tip the scales in their favor, or to obtain the occult power they so desperately desired. Or maybe you are descended from drow who intentionally bred with fiends and performed horrific rituals to imbue themselves with demonic power. Both elven and fiendish blood now course through your veins in a constant battle for your soul. You count as both a native outsider and an elf for any effects related to your species. You use the height, weight, and age charts for elves instead of those normally used for tieflings, and you gain an elf’s immunity to magic sleep effects. This trait alters your type and replaces fiendish sorcery.
Embri-Blooded You are descended from embri GS3 who made a deal with a devil or other fiend. As a tiefling, your appearance retains many characteristics the unusual mollusk-like embri. You count as both a native outsider and an aberration for any effects related to your species. You use the height and weight charts for embri instead of those normally used for tieflings (but you still age as a standard tiefling). You gain the talons GS3 and masked emotions GS3 species traits of an embri. This trait alters your type and replaces skilled.
Sahuagin-Blooded You are descended not from humans, but from the sahuagin, a species of cruel fish-people known for taming sharks and performing ghastly blood sacrifices to their fiendish patrons in their vast undersea kingdoms. You gain the aquatic subtype, the amphibious special quality, and a swim speed of 30 feet. You can also communicate telepathically with sharks to a distance of 100 feet; this communication is limited to simple concepts, such as “attack,” “come,” and “defend.” This trait replaces fiendish sorcery and skilled.
Small Tiefling You appearance and abilities have been clearly influenced by your Small-sized humanoid ancestors—perhaps gnomes, goblins, halflings, ratfolk, or the like. You are size Small. This trait alters your size.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
